b.x: 01 Interior room, the lowest. Bathroom, hall, basement. Away from windows.
02 Lie down. Cover the head. Not the overpass. Not the balcony ‘to watch’.
03 People of the house in the same room. The pet if you can. Do not go out in the wind.
04 After: a wire on the ground is live. A tree in the lines — distance, the utility, no saw.
